title: P6 Activity Release 26 non-exact registry alias resolution evidence
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
certification_boundary: Identity mapping is resolved for unambiguous aliases and remains not certified for persistence/import-export deployment. Ambiguous cases are intentionally unresolved.
rules: Registry-only names remain stable Shared-Core identities; resolution is represented as an interchange alias relationship.
Oracle REST wire types are not silently treated as identical to internal registry types; enum/date normalization remains an explicit boundary.
No alias is certified from name similarity alone.
Ambiguous aliases are not forced to one P6 field when Oracle exposes multiple semantically distinct candidates.
No Activity dataclass, scheduler, CPM, EVM, or client calculation changes are implied by this artifact.

resolved_aliases.semantic_evidence: Oracle Activity Id is the short activity identifier within the project.
resolved_aliases.internal_evidence: The existing interchange mapper can represent Id as the external source field while preserving ActivityId as the canonical Shared-Core field; regression covers import/export name preservation.

resolved_aliases.semantic_evidence: Oracle Activity Name is the activity name.
resolved_aliases.internal_evidence: The existing interchange mapper can represent Name as the external source field while preserving ActivityName as the canonical Shared-Core field; regression covers import/export name preservation.

resolved_aliases.semantic_evidence: Oracle Activity Status is the current activity status; the REST representation is a string.
resolved_aliases.internal_evidence: The alias relationship is name-only at the interchange boundary; internal enum representation remains unchanged and requires no client-side calculation.

resolved_aliases.semantic_evidence: Oracle Activity Type is the documented activity-type field with enumerated values; REST represents it as a string.
resolved_aliases.internal_evidence: The alias relationship is name-only at the interchange boundary; internal enum representation remains unchanged.

resolved_aliases.semantic_evidence: Oracle defines RemainingEarlyStartDate as the scheduled start of remaining work; the scheduler computes it and the project manager may update it manually. Oracle's P6-to-Primavera-Cloud schedule mapping also maps remainingStartDate to RemainingEarlyStartDate.
resolved_aliases.internal_evidence: The authoritative scheduler-output evidence already keeps RemainingEarlyStartDate separate from the generic Activity.remaining_start model field; this alias does not add another scheduler calculation.

resolved_aliases.semantic_evidence: Oracle LastUpdateUser is the name of the user who last updated the activity and is exposed by the Activity REST contract and export inventory.
resolved_aliases.internal_evidence: The existing Shared-Core registry already treats UpdateUser as non-writable; the alias regression preserves that identity without introducing a calculation path.
resolved_aliases.note: The current registry computed flag is intentionally preserved in this tranche; stored-vs-derived metadata is a separate reconciliation gate.

unresolved_aliases.reason: Oracle exposes multiple owner representations. The current registry string seed does not establish whether it means the single owner user ID, owner IDs, owner names, or a product-specific display reference.
unresolved_aliases.next_evidence: Inspect actual internal Activity owner persistence/interchange semantics before choosing one canonical field.

unresolved_aliases.reason: Oracle exposes both a calendar name and the unique calendar object ID. The current generic Calendar string seed does not prove which identity it represents.
unresolved_aliases.next_evidence: Inspect activity calendar persistence and existing interchange fixtures; preserve both official P6 fields rather than collapsing them.

unresolved_aliases.reason: Oracle exposes distinct remaining early and remaining late finish dates. A single generic registry field cannot be certified to either one without internal scheduling/read-model semantics.
unresolved_aliases.next_evidence: Trace the existing authoritative scheduler output/read model and exact interchange representation before mapping.
